function.name: pause
function.description: Pause the bot until something happens. Must be the only call of the batch.

function.name: restart
function.description: Reset the context, keeping memory. Must be the only call of the batch.

function.name: fly
function.description: Land at a specific grid cell.

headfirst.description: Fly head first (use for tight spaces or unstuck).

function.name: fly_direction
function.description: Fly a number of cells along one of the grid axes.

direction.description: Which way to fly, relative to the grid.

n.description: How many cells to cross. Positive.

function.name: approach
function.description: Fly to the interaction point of a block, from where the action below is possible.

action.description: What you intend to do at that block once you arrive.

function.name: plan
function.description: Write down the goal and the steps of a task that spans several turns. This is where planning happens — never in text. The plan stays in front of you for the rest of the task.

goal.description: The objective from [GAME CHAT], in your own words. One line.

steps.description: The steps you are going to run, in order. One line.

function.name: memory
function.description: Store a persistent key-value pair; it survives a context reset.

key.description: Short name of what is being remembered.

function.name: select
function.description: Select the grid to work on. Returns its axes.

name.description: Name of the grid, or part of it.

function.name: position
function.description: Your own coordinates on the selected grid.

function.name: status
function.description: Your health, hydrogen and energy.

function.name: say
function.description: Send a chat message to the player. Keep it extremely short.

function.name: exit
function.description: Leave the cockpit or seat you are in.

function.name: overview
function.description: List the blocks of the selected grid by category.

function.name: integrity
function.description: List the damaged blocks of the selected grid.

function.name: projection
function.description: Build status of the projection on the selected grid.

function.name: near
function.description: Describe the 3x3x3 cube of cells around a point.

i.description: Grid coordinate I. Omit all three to use your own cell.

function.name: free
function.description: List the free cells of the 3x3x3 cube around a point.

i.description: Grid coordinate I. Omit all three to use your own cell.

function.name: inventory
function.description: List the items you are carrying.

function.name: inventory_block
function.description: List the inventory of one block.

function.name: inventories
function.description: List every inventory on the selected grid.

function.name: recharge_list
function.description: List the blocks of the selected grid you can recharge at.

function.name: search
function.description: Search the nearby grids for an item or a block by name.

query.description: Part of the name to look for.

limit.description: How many results at most. Default 5.

function.name: distance
function.description: Distance from you to a block.

function.name: distance_between
function.description: Distance between two cells.

i2.description: Grid coordinate I of the second cell.

j2.description: Grid coordinate J of the second cell.

k2.description: Grid coordinate K of the second cell.

function.name: points
function.description: List the cells you can stand in to interact with a block.

function.name: info
function.description: Detailed information about one block: size, state, components.

function.name: route
function.description: Shortest conveyor path between two blocks, with the tube pieces it needs. Either end may be a drafted block; drafted cells count as occupied.

i2.description: Grid coordinate I of the second cell.

j2.description: Grid coordinate J of the second cell.

k2.description: Grid coordinate K of the second cell.

function.name: transfer
function.description: Move a number of items from one block's inventory to another's.

i2.description: Grid coordinate I of the second cell.

j2.description: Grid coordinate J of the second cell.

k2.description: Grid coordinate K of the second cell.

function.name: transfer_all
function.description: Move everything from one block's inventory to another's.

i2.description: Grid coordinate I of the second cell.

j2.description: Grid coordinate J of the second cell.

k2.description: Grid coordinate K of the second cell.

function.name: draft
function.description: Plan one block. Nothing is built; the player sees the whole draft as a projection.

type.description: Block type name, e.g. 'Light Armor Block'.

up.description: Which way its top points. Only together with facing.

function.name: draft_conveyor
function.description: Plan one conveyor tube piece, named by the two directions it opens onto.

port2.description: Second opening, different from the first.

function.name: draft_show
function.description: List what is in the draft.

function.name: draft_undo
function.description: Drop the last block from the draft.

function.name: draft_clear
function.description: Drop the whole draft.

function.name: grind
function.description: Grind the block at a cell.

function.name: weld
function.description: Weld the block at a cell. Incremental: several trips may be needed.

function.name: get
function.description: Take things out of a block's inventory. Write down everything you need from it — one entry per item type, all in one call.

items.description: What to take. One entry per item type.

count.description: How many. Omit to take all of them.

function.name: put
function.description: Put things away. Write down everything you are carrying that has to go into this block — one entry per item type, all in one call.

items.description: What to put in. One entry per item type.

count.description: How many. Omit to put all of them.

function.name: put_all_components
function.description: Put every component you carry into a block's inventory.

function.name: build
function.description: Build every drafted block within reach. Needs the player's approval first. Repeat after moving.

function.name: place
function.description: Build one block right now, at minimum integrity. For a single block the player asked for by name; a structure is drafted instead.

up.description: Which way its top points. Only together with facing.

function.name: place_conveyor
function.description: Build one conveyor tube piece right now, at minimum integrity.

port2.description: Second opening, different from the first.

function.name: enter
function.description: Enter the cockpit or seat at a cell.

function.name: recharge
function.description: Recharge from the block at a cell.
